ENRICHMENT 2026-08-14 (Gabriel's request to close the Economics-blind-spot documented in SKILL.md Limitations): researched real physical specs for this deal. Two categories of missing fact needed DIFFERENT treatment. (1) STRUCTURAL/DIMENSIONAL specs (construction type, clear height, dock/drive-in count, per-building SF) do not change on their own between the 2026-06-09 freeze date and the later source documents (weeks-to-months apart, not decades) -- CORRECTED 2026-08-14 per REFUTE finding F5: the original wording said these are usable from 'any point in time,' which overstated the theory (a 1966-built structure's ORIGINAL dimensions are stable, but the building itself is not immune to renovation/demolition/addition over 60 years -- the real invariance claim is only that nothing material changed in the narrow freeze-to-source window, which is a much safer claim and the one actually relied on here). This narrower framing does NOT extend to CONDITION (Product & Physical's construction-and-condition sub-score) -- condition genuinely can change even over weeks, so scoring uses ONLY the pre-6/9-admissible structural-condition finding (see inputs.structural_condition), never the later OM's own condition claims. It also does not extend to a rail spur being described as 'active' -- the named railroad ceased operating in 1976, so 'active [railroad name withheld] rail spur' in the sourced OM is almost certainly stale boilerplate language carried across years of re-listings, not a verified current-as-of-freeze-date fact; carried in inputs.physical.docks_drive_ins as a physical-infrastructure detail (the spur's physical presence), not as evidence the spur was in active use at 6/9. (2) TENANCY/OCCUPANCY is explicitly a genuine UNKNOWN at 6/9 (ORA's own DD-Critical status said 'rent roll unreconciled' through the freeze date, corroborated by pre-6/9 Morning Brief pages) -- this is NOT a research gap to backfill, it is an irreducible fact of this deal's history. Later occupancy data exists (a Crexi listing's per-building tenant mix, and a later ~83% vacant portfolio-wide figure) but using it would import hindsight into a frozen pre-Phase-II snapshot, so it is deliberately excluded. Tenancy & Lease therefore stays null -- this is why confidence is MEDIUM, not HIGH: 6 of 7 categories are now resolved, but the 7th is structurally unresolvable without breaking the frozen-snapshot discipline, not merely under-researched. See SKILL.md for the full writeup.

PER-BUILDING SIZE-GATE FINDING (surfaced by the enrichment, not previously known): the researched per-building breakdown shows the North portfolio's 'Main Building' (126,924 SF) is either a single building over the skill's 50,000 SF/building gate, or an internal split into a 74,700 SF 'Building A' section plus a 52,224 SF 'remainder' section -- EITHER reading breaches the 50K/building gate (both sub-figures individually exceed it too). Building-count ambiguity is unresolved from available sources (the OM describes it as one main building with named internal areas, which reads as a single structure, not multiple discrete buildings). The original 6/9 screen never caught this because per-building SF was completely unknown at that time -- a genuine screen-time gap, not something Ruling 5 already flagged. Frozen as `main_building_sf_ambiguity` below; the replay should screen this as a GATE-FLAGGED exception (Ruling 5: flag, not kill) given every plausible reading breaches.

Year-built cross-source conflict (reported, not resolved): Notion Deal Sourcing Log / this golden set = 1966; County Auditor CAMA (parcel [C-3]) = 1967 (immaterial to the vintage ramp -- both are far below the 1995 floor-ramp threshold); a LATER (post-7/9-termination) re-listing of the north parcels states 1998, which is inadmissible here -- that OM is a post-freeze re-marketing of the property, not a fact knowable at the 6/9 screen, and is used ONLY for its time-invariant structural details (construction type, clear height, loading), never its stated vintage, price, or 'value-add' framing.

South-parcel loading detail (docks/drive-ins) was not found in any sourced document -- only the North parcels' OM had full loading detail. South parcels' construction/loading fields below are partially null as a result; this is a smaller, honestly-flagged residual gap, not swept into the Tenancy discussion above.

NOI is not disclosed on this 6/9 snapshot; Basis rests on an [est] all-in build. The enrichment adds a real, sourced pre-6/9 CapEx input (roof/structural repair estimate) that materially changes this from the original replay's price+closing-only all-in -- see inputs.structural_condition.
